title: agropyron trachycaulum var. latiglume
intro: Agropyron trachycaulum var. latiglume, commonly known as wheat grass, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing stress, improving digestion, and supporting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of wheat grass include its ability to stimulate the immune system, promote wound healing, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of wheat grass include chlorophyll, vitamins A and E, and minerals such as iron and potassium, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
